integrity: Exhaustive finite computations are explicit, reproducible with Python standard library; no extrapolation, external certification, or independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Specific 25-vertex Paley clique complex and its additive translation group; does not classify larger Paley graphs, the whole automorphism group, or persistence. Numerical Betti ranks are already implied by Cioaba--Mim 2026; original additions are a nonabelian homotopy certificate and a complete translation character.
title: Topological and translation-equivariant homology classification of the \(25\)-vertex Paley clique complex
